title: Stage 5.4 Amendment 3 — TS-4 BBox-Aware Constrained EMA Formal
research_question: On frozen Full Dev166 and Confirmatory Dev142, does preregistered TS-4 preserve the fixed-EMA temporal benefit while repairing the strong-motion bbox visibility failure that remained under TS-3 center containment?
scientific_rationale: TS-3 achieved containment=1.0 but visible>=0.90 remained equal to TS-1 and strong visibility failed on both analysis sets. TS-4 changes only the output safety definition to the discrete maximum-visible frozen-bbox set.

ts4_algorithm.name: bbox_aware_constrained_ema_v1
objective: among maximizers minimize distance from integer TS-1 proposal
ts4_algorithm.one_axis: For [b1,b2), extent C, continuous maximum-overlap plateau is [b2-C,b1] if bbox extent<=C else [b1,b2-C]. Intersect with [0,floor(F-C)]; if the plateau lies outside, choose its nearest legal boundary. Contained integers are the discrete argmax; if none, evaluate the two adjacent legal integers. If every legal overlap is zero, the complete legal integer domain is the tie set.
ts4_algorithm.two_axis_proof: Intersection area factorizes as overlap_x*overlap_y with positive fixed bbox area; independent one-axis argmax sets therefore form the exact 2-D argmax rectangle.
ts4_algorithm.projection: coordinatewise clip of integer TS-1 proposal to the discrete argmax rectangle
ts4_algorithm.bbox_le_crop: full containment iff discrete maximum overlap equals bbox extent
ts4_algorithm.bbox_gt_crop: maximum possible overlap; no threshold or margin
ts4_algorithm.frame_edge: sanitized frozen bbox and legal placement intersection
ts4_algorithm.half_open_integer: half-open bbox/crop; float bbox converted exactly through decimal Fraction; exact derived crop height; deterministic ceil/floor and tie set

full_dev166.definition: All 166 whole video_ids and frozen Stage 5.1 frame identities in stage5_3_formal_manifest_v1

confirmatory_dev142.definition: Frozen Dev166 minus Stage5.4 Smoke24 whole video_ids

decision_rule.application: Every gate independently passes on Full Dev166 and Confirmatory Dev142.
mechanism_checks: TS-4 bbox visibility pointwise no worse than TS-3
TS-4 strong visibility strictly better than TS-3
TS-4 visible>=0.90 no worse than TS-3
TS-4 objective realized on every eligible frame
TS-4 displacement/acceleration/>0.20 no worse than TS-2
decision_rule.gate_failure: final result for this protocol; no repair or rerun

fields: TS-4 incremental correction relative to TS-3

statistical_plan: Complete frozen development populations with matched frame-level treatment comparisons; prespecified practical effect-size gates, no outcome-adaptive tests, no p-value selection, all failed and nonfailed gates reported.
limitations: primary bbox is frozen detector output, not GT
Dev166 and Dev142 are development sets
PASS does not establish official-test performance
references: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065
